name: Police Commission Meeting - Jul 15, 2026
agenda_text:
BURBANK POLICE COMMISSION
  CITY OF BURBANK
  REGULAR MEETING
  JULY 15, 2026 - 6:00 P.M.

  AGENDA
This agenda contains a summary of each item of business that the Police Commission may discuss or act
on at this meeting. The entire agenda packet, consisting of staff reports and any other documents
relating to each item on this agenda, is on file in the office of the Chief of Police located at 200 North
Third Street.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Police Commission Meeting will be held in person in the City Council
Chamber, located at 275 E. Olive Avenue, on Wednesday, July 15, 2026, at 6:00 p.m., to discuss matters
on the attached agenda.

Auxiliary aids and services are available for individuals with speech, vision, or hearing impairments (48-
hour notice is required). For more information, please contact the ADA Coordinator at (818) 238-5424.

How to View the Meeting:
Local Cable: Spectrum Channel 6 or AT&T Uverse Channel 99.
YouTube Live Streaming Channel: Click here.
City Website Live Streaming: Click here..

Public Comment Options: To speak during Public Comment, members of the public may speak for three
minutes in-person in the Council Chamber or they may call 818-238-3335. Members of the public who
attend the meeting in Chamber will speak first, followed by those phoning in their comments.

Interpretation Requests:
If you would like to participate in Public Comments and require an interpreter, please telephone the City
Clerk’s Office at (818) 238-5851 at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting.

Si desea participar en los comentarios públicos y necesita un intérprete, por favor llame a la Oficina de la
Secretaria Municipal al (818) 238-5851 al menos 48 horas antes de la reunión.

Եթե ցանկանում եք մասնակցել հանրային մեկնաբանություններին և թարգմանիչ եք պահանջում,
խնդրում ենք զանգահարել քաղաքապետարանի գրասենյակ՝ (818) 238-5851 հեռախոսահամարով
հանդիպումից 48 ժամ առաջ:

A.  CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL

B.  FLAG SALUTE

C.  COMMISSION ANNOUNCEMENTS AND REPORTING OUT BY COMMISSIONERS AND
  AD HOC SUBCOMMITTEES
  Brief announcements by Commissioners and brief reports regarding activities of Ad Hoc
  subcommittees.

D.  PUBLIC COMMENTS – THREE MINUTES

E.  COMMISSION RESPONSE TO PUBLIC COMMENTS
  The Commission cannot act on items raised during public comment. Commissioners may
  only provide brief non-substantive responses, request clarification, or refer the item to staff.
 Burbank Police Commission
July 15, 2026
Page 2

F.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES FROM THE JUNE 17, 2026 MEETING

G.  ITEMS OF BUSINESS
  1.  Presentation, discussion, and recommendations (if applicable) on the Department's pursuit
  policy to include risks/rewards, safety considerations, and public education opportunities
  2.  Discussion and possible recommendations on the use of public safety surveillance
  technology, data storage, and technology procurement, to include ALPR, public safety
  cameras, marketplace data tracking, unmanned aircraft systems, real time information
  systems, and any biometric recognition technologies used by the Department
  3.  General announcements by Chief Quintero - brief announcements regarding upcoming
  events and/or items of note related to the police department

H.  INTRODUCTION OF AGENDA ITEMS FOR FUTURE MEETINGS

  Agendized for future a meeting:
  o Presentation and discussion of the annual RIPA report (when the report becomes
  available)

I.  NEXT MEETING DATE –  August 19, 2026
  6:00 p.m., City Council Chamber

J.  ADJOURNMENT
